omissions: Root-bearing axes grew downwards or horizontally; lateral roots spread horizontally, suggesting absent positive gravitropism. This distinction should constrain model architecture. [Matsunaga and Tomescu 2016, full text](https://mihaibotany.online/pdf/MatsunagaTomescu2016.pdf).

Additional geometry includes root-tuft spacing of 2–40 mm (mean 11 mm, n = 161) and an approximately 12-cm rooted horizon. Neither establishes an organism's maximum rooting extent. [Matsunaga and Tomescu 2016, full text](https://mihaibotany.online/pdf/MatsunagaTomescu2016.pdf).
Spatial branching intervals of 2 to at least 25 cm are available despite unknown annual branching rates. [Matsunaga and Tomescu 2017, full text](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5604611/).

Fourteen sporangia occur on three fragments; sampling spans 1.5–1.8 m vertically and at most 10 m laterally. Representativeness needs qualification. [Matsunaga and Tomescu 2017, full text](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5604611/).

Elevated fertile structures are undocumented, and secondary vascular tissue is absent. Height investment therefore remains a hypothetical comparison. [Matsunaga and Tomescu 2017, full text](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5604611/).

The palynological assemblage lacks a securely identified lycophyte spore counterpart. Dispersed spores cannot currently calibrate Sengelia reproduction or dispersal. [Noetinger et al. 2021, abstract only](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/spp2.1395).

The earlier paper tentatively suggests submergence possibly exceeding one month, while explicitly acknowledging unknown microconchid growth rates. This is a hypothesis, not calibration. [Caruso and Tomescu 2012, full text](https://mihaibotany.online/pdf/Caruso%202012%20Lethaia.pdf).
model_transfer_assessment: The strongest contrast is modular spreading and burial resilience; height and reproductive allocation are exploratory comparisons. Numerical inputs belong to the Cottonwood material subsequently named S. radicans, and the named specimens are correctly attributed illustrations, not the sole measurement sources. The exclusions correctly protect against converting preserved geometry into rates, fecundity or clone identity. Add explicit limits on energetic costs and hydraulic performance, and preserve the developmental coupling between leafy shoots and root-bearing axes.
overall: The card is scientifically careful: none of the 25 checked claim groups contains a substantive numerical, taxonomic or attribution error. Its main improvement would be to incorporate additional architectural constraints and sharpen the distinction between supported morphology and proposed allocation experiments. The full 2021 palynological argument and Crossref API verification remained inaccessible; the broad age assignment is supported by the accessible abstract.
